subject: Can I run a executable file in ShinyApps.io?

messages.author: ca07ff5cbd0bfac9
messages.subject: Can I run a executable file in ShinyApps.io?
parts:
My shiny app includes a "system(...)" to invoke a external executable file. After I deployed it to ShinyApps.io, the app stopped to responds. 
I have looked into the log of the running app. It say that : Permission Denied. 
So I assumed that the server forbids running of executable file. 
Does anyone know about this? Is there a way to get around this ?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Can I run a executable file in ShinyApps.io?
parts:
Can you let us know what is in ...? Did you use sudo in the command
(which will definitely fail)? I can run system('echo foo')
successfully.

Regards,
Yihui
